children: Kurzymski Maciej, an officer serving as Chief Accounting Officer, reported the sale of common stock on September 16, 2026. The report states a weighted average selling price of $268.42 per share with shares sold in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $263.22 to $274.14. The total reported sale amount was $616,023 to cover tax withholding on settled restricted stock units. After the reported disposition, Kurzymski Maciej directly owned 77,391 shares of common stock.
